summary: E2E frontend auth flow verified after backend brought up. Both /login (admin) and /registration (new user) succeed and land in the authenticated /demo-trade area with market data + demo wallet. No client_id error overlay; Google button rendered but disabled on both pages as intended.

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket to wss://<host>/api/socket.io fails to establish (console warning: 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established'). Chart still renders via REST polling; likely socket.io transport / ingress websocket-upgrade issue.

action_items: Investigate socket.io websocket handshake failure on wss://fund-runner.preview.emergentagent.com/api/socket.io/ (transport=websocket). Likely ingress path or CORS/upgrade config; polling may be working but realtime updates should be verified.

Clarify expected demo wallet amount: test brief said '$10k demo wallet' for new registrations, but UI shows $500.00 DEMO for both admin and newly-registered user. Confirm whether $500 is intentional (matches seed) or backend should credit $10,000.
critical_code_review_comments: GoogleButton correctly guards against missing REACT_APP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (renders disabled) — good.
Registration form has no visible client-side validation error surface when country is empty (submit silently no-ops). Consider showing a validation message.
Socket.io client should log a clearer error and fall back gracefully; currently only browser-default warning is shown.
